data.name: Avila
data.abstract: The Avila data set has been extracted from 800 images of the 'Avila Bible', an XII century giant Latin copy of the Bible.  The prediction task consists in associating each pattern to a copyist.

additional_info.summary:
Data have been normalized by using the Z-normalization method and divided into two data sets: a training set containing 10430 samples, and a test set containing the 10437 samples.
